description: Publish messages or briefly wait for new messages on any MQTT broker that exposes a WebSocket listener.

fields.label: WebSocket URL
fields.description: The complete ws:// or wss:// URL of the broker's MQTT-over-WebSocket listener, including its path. Private targets require a self-hosted runtime with OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK enabled.

fields.label: Username
fields.description: Optional MQTT CONNECT username configured by the broker operator.

fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: Optional fixed MQTT Client ID. When omitted, each action uses a random Client ID. Alibaba Cloud device credentials require GroupID@@@DeviceID.

fields.label: Password
fields.description: Optional MQTT CONNECT password configured by the broker operator. A username is required when set.

fields.label: Protocol Version
fields.description: MQTT protocol version. Use 3.1.1 by default, or enter 5.0 when the broker supports MQTT 5.

fields.label: Alibaba Cloud Instance ID
fields.description: Alibaba Cloud ApsaraMQ instance ID for unique-certificate-per-device authentication. Configure it with a Client ID, then either save both device access key fields or pass them to each action.

fields.label: Alibaba Cloud Device AccessKey ID
fields.description: Optional Alibaba Cloud device AccessKey ID. Leave both device key fields empty to provide them at action runtime.

fields.label: Alibaba Cloud Device AccessKey Secret
fields.description: Optional Alibaba Cloud device AccessKey secret used to sign the Client ID.

actions.name: publish_message
actions.description: Publish one UTF-8 or base64-encoded message through a short-lived MQTT-over-WebSocket connection.

topic.description: Exact MQTT topic to publish to. Topic wildcards are not allowed.

payload.description: Message payload encoded according to payloadEncoding.

payloadEncoding.description: How to decode payload before publishing it.

retain.description: Whether the broker should retain this message for future subscribers.

aliyunDeviceAccessKeyId.description: Alibaba Cloud device AccessKey ID. Provide it together with aliyunDeviceAccessKeySecret when the connection is configured for runtime device credentials.

aliyunDeviceAccessKeySecret.description: Alibaba Cloud device AccessKey secret used to sign the Client ID.

inputSchema.description: The message to publish to the connected MQTT broker.

topic.description: Topic the message was published to.

retain.description: Whether the MQTT PUBLISH retain flag was requested.

protocolVersion.description: MQTT protocol version used for the connection.

deliveryAcknowledged.description: Whether the MQTT publish acknowledgement flow completed. This does not mean a consumer processed the message.

actions.name: receive_messages
actions.description: Wait briefly for new messages on an MQTT topic filter. This is not a persistent subscription and can miss messages between action calls.

topicFilter.description: MQTT topic filter to subscribe to, including + or # wildcards when needed.

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for messages before returning.

maxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages to collect before returning.

payloadEncoding.description: How received message payloads should be returned.

aliyunDeviceAccessKeyId.description: Alibaba Cloud device AccessKey ID. Provide it together with aliyunDeviceAccessKeySecret when the connection is configured for runtime device credentials.

aliyunDeviceAccessKeySecret.description: Alibaba Cloud device AccessKey secret used to sign the Client ID.

inputSchema.description: The bounded MQTT subscription to open for this action call.

topic.description: Exact MQTT topic the message was published to.

payload.description: Message payload encoded according to payloadEncoding.

retain.description: Whether the broker marked this as a retained message.

duplicate.description: Whether the MQTT DUP flag was set.

items.description: One MQTT message received from the broker.

messages.description: Messages received after the subscription became active.

timedOut.description: Whether the collection window ended because timeoutSeconds elapsed.

protocolVersion.description: MQTT protocol version used for the connection.

outputSchema.description: Messages observed during the bounded subscription window.
